step: enumerate+score (Atlas step 1, Northern Rivers: Queensland border to the Clarence; Wikivoyage region, town and See/Do pages, NSW NPWS park pages, Visit NSW and Visit Byron Bay tourism pages, Tweed Shire holidays page, OSM Overpass lighthouse/attraction nodes, Wikipedia shire and category pages; blind verdicts are step 3, not done here)
scoring: views = English Wikipedia per-article views (all-access, user), 12 months, filled by score-candidates.ts; 0 with no article or when the title only redirects to a broader article. counted_sources = visitor-oriented sources only (Wikivoyage, NSW National Parks, Visit NSW, Visit Byron Bay, Tweed Shire); Wikipedia and OSM are in other_sources and not counted. Coordinates from the listing or OSM where given, else from Wikipedia via score-candidates.ts; null where no source coordinate was found.
